name: SDA Hymnal 1985
note: All 698 numbers and titles. The words are copyrighted: add them under your church's licence (More → Import licensed words), or use the public-domain words from the Church Hymnal 1941 where the hymn is in it.

name: Church Hymnal 1941
note: All 703 hymns of the 1941 SDA Church Hymnal with words offline (older public-domain texts).

name: Advent Lofliedere (Afrikaans, offline)
note: All 481 Afrikaans hymns with their words, offline (shared with the owners' permission). About 150 play the SDA Hymnal tune.

name: English
note: Shared Hymns in English: praise choruses (1–45), Malmesbury Praise (101–148, with their own titles) and hymns shared by SDA Sabbath churches (501 and up). Words are included for public-domain songs; add the others under your church's licence.
